name: Proto-Cushitic (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Proto-Cushitic is the reconstructed ancestor of the Cushitic branch of Afroasiatic; its Agaw (Central Cushitic) members are the classic substrate of Ethiopian Semitic (Amharic, Tigrinya). It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table: the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table needs a cited reconstruction that states its notation and the sound value of each symbol.

sources.author: Appleyard, D.

sources.notes: Reference for the Cushitic substrate of Ethiopian Semitic (structural node only).
